title.zh: SOON因异常提现暂停svmBNB及主网跨链桥服务并展开调查
title.en: 【SOON：因异常提现暂停 svmBNB 及主网跨链服务】

current_state.zh: SOON Foundation halted the svmBNB and SOON Mainnet bridges after detecting abnormal withdrawal activity on 31 October and says both will stay offline pending an investigation, without disclosing the scale of assets involved.
current_state.en: SOON Foundation halted the svmBNB and SOON Mainnet bridges after detecting abnormal withdrawal activity on 31 October and says both will stay offline pending an investigation, without disclosing the scale of assets involved.
